Paradise Plains.note: No Full Board Package tier offered here - Ground Package only

childPolicyLuxurySuites.oneAdultOneChild: Adult pays single, child 50% of per-person sharing

Paradise Plains.groundPackageIncludes: Full board, community fee $80pp, curated spirits/wines/beers/soft drinks, unstaffed sundowner at scenic point, packed picnic breakfasts, shared game drives, free exclusive vehicle (min 4 pax), Musiara airstrip transfers, laundry (excl. underwear), free Wilder inter-camp transfers

The River Camp, Ol Pejeta.occupancyNote: No triples or extra beds at The River Camp
The River Camp, Ol Pejeta.minimumStay: Easter (22-28 Mar 27) and Christmas (24 Dec 27-3 Jan 28) require min 2 nights - implies otherwise no set minimum stated on this page, differs from the group's standard 2-night minimum

Lerai Safari Camp.occupancyNote: Only 1 triple available, subject to availability

mandatoryFees.note: All rates inclusive of bednight & community fees ($80 adult / $40 child)

Entim Main Camp.confidenceNote: No Family Suite option found on Entim Main Camp's own page (only Luxury Suite) - contrast with Entim Private Camp below which DOES offer a Family Suite. Entim Main's Luxury Suite pricing is identical cell-for-cell to Entim Private's Luxury Suite pricing - a cross-property standardized-base-rate pattern consistent with this project's prior finding for Soroi Larsens/Amboseli.

Entim Private Camp.familySuiteTCs: 2 adults+1 child: child 75% of single room rate; 2 adults+2 kids: each child 75% of per-person sharing; 1 adult+2 children: adult pays single, children 75% each; 3 adults+1 child: 3 adults pay sharing rate (3rd at single rate), child 50%

Ilkeliani.childPolicyDistinct: Children of ALL ages permitted (unlike the 8+ restriction at every other Wilder Mara camp); child rate applies 5-11 years; under-5 free (1 per tent, sharing adult room)

PremiumTent.occupancyNote: No triples or extra beds at Ilkeliani Premium Tents

commonPolicy.minimumStay: 2 nights for all properties except The Cliff Nakuru and The River Camp
commonPolicy.singleRoomPolicy: Max 3 singles per booking; 4th+ charged at double room rate
commonPolicy.vehicleColorRequirement: 4x4 vehicles must be green or earth tones only

lateDeparture.note: Includes lunch & airstrip transfers; tent checkout still 10am but camp facilities usable after

longStay.stay4get1free: During green/off-peak - conservancy/park/bednight fees still payable on all nights
longStay.restriction: Single-property only, not combinable across properties

specialOffers.stay3pay2: Off-peak/Green season only, The River Camp & Lerai Safari Camp only, not combinable with other offers
specialOffers.combinationRestriction: Long stay offers cannot combine with circuit discounts; park/conservancy fees always charged separately regardless of offer

hotAirBalloonSafaris_MasaiMara.childPolicy: 5-11yrs = child; 12+ = adult; all children must be accompanied by adult; children age 5-11 must not exceed number of adults in group
hotAirBalloonSafaris_MasaiMara.notCarried: Under 5, pregnancy 3rd trimester, diagnosed osteoporosis, known heart disease, recent injury/surgery

cliffBoatSafari_LakeNakuru.includes: Breakfast (AM) or lunch (PM) on board, beverages, professional binoculars, Lake Nakuru guide/naturalist
cliffBoatSafari_LakeNakuru.childPolicy: 13+ full adult rate; under 9 not allowed
